claims.text: The manual says that to check the battery voltage you should contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre or a battery service centre.
The motorcycle is provided with a 12 V - 8 Ah VRLA battery.
This partly answers your question. The retrieved manual information does not give a rider-performed procedure, tool or target voltage reading for checking the battery voltage yourself.

unanswered_parts: A rider-performed procedure, tool or acceptable voltage reading for checking battery voltage
